description: Samuel Bérubé, Ali Nazemi and Naota Hanasaki publish MATLAB scripts and input arrays for comparing large-scale reservoir-operation rules. Zenodo provides the source files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Its four-page README names hydrological- and calendar-year data, observed level, storage and discharge, inflow, rainfall, evaporation, demands, reservoir conversion matrices, and 10,000 Latin-hypercube parameter sets. The main script simulates storage and release under ten algorithm variants and scores outputs against observations; calibration and figure scripts are also included. This can test how rule choice and parameter calibration affect reservoir operations in water-resource simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this suite. A limitation is that named input reservoirs and the paper DOI are not resolved on the public page, and MATLAB is a separate dependency. The scripts and arrays were not executed; simulated storage and reported fit metrics were not reproduced.
